Standard Operating Procedures — Production Line A
Document: SOP-001 | Rev: 2.3 | Date: 2025-11-15 | Author: Ing. M. Bianchi — Process Engineering
1. Station Dependencies
ST01_FILLING → ST02_SEALING → ST03_LABELLING → ST04_PACKAGING. A fault at any station propagates
downstream unless the line is halted.

[SOP-001:p1:table1]
Station ID: ST01_FILLING; Zone: Production Area; Depends On: —; Downstream Effect: Feeds ST02_SEALING
Station ID: ST02_SEALING; Zone: Production Area; Depends On: ST01; Downstream Effect: Feeds ST03; thermal fault → ST04 speed reduction
Station ID: ST03_LABELLING; Zone: Production Area; Depends On: ST02; Downstream Effect: Feeds ST04_PACKAGING
Station ID: ST04_PACKAGING; Zone: Production Area; Depends On: ST03; Downstream Effect: Final output
Station ID: SRV01_SERVERROOM; Zone: Server Room; Depends On: HVAC; Downstream Effect: SCADA control; failure → line halt
Station ID: WRH01_WAREHOUSE; Zone: General Warehouse; Depends On: COMPRESSOR; Downstream Effect: Cold storage — product quality
Station ID: CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE; Zone: Chemical Storage; Depends On: HVAC; Downstream Effect: Hazardous materials — safety critical
Station ID: RND01_RDLAB; Zone: R&D Lab; Depends On: HVAC; Downstream Effect: Precision experiments — climate sensitive
Station ID: CAF01_CAFETERIA; Zone: Cafeteria; Depends On: HVAC; Downstream Effect: Occupant comfort — food safety

2. Station-Level Operating Rules
2.1 ST01_FILLING
RULE-ST01-01: FLW MUST be maintained between 112 and 128 L/min.
RULE-ST01-02: If TMP exceeds 26°C, reduce speed by 10% and notify QC.
RULE-ST01-03: PRS drop below 3.3 bar — inspect inlet valve within 5 min.
2.2 ST02_SEALING
RULE-ST02-01: TMP MUST remain between 175°C and 195°C.
RULE-ST02-02: TMP > 210°C (CRITICAL) — emergency stop ST02, ST03, ST04.
RULE-ST02-03: CUR increase >1.5 A above nominal sustained >5 min — schedule maintenance.
RULE-ST02-04: CUR drift at ST02_SEALING CORRELATES with speed reduction at ST04_PACKAGING due to shared electrical coupling. Monitor ST04_PACKAGING-SPD whenever ST02_SEALING-CUR triggers a WARNING.
2.3 ST03_LABELLING
RULE-ST03-01: TEN MUST be between 1.8 and 2.6 N.
RULE-ST03-02: CNT below 110 pcs/min — check for label jam. Below 100 (CRITICAL): halt.
RULE-ST03-03: TEN STUCK >10 consecutive samples — sensor failure.
2.4 ST04_PACKAGING
RULE-ST04-01: VIB > 0.20 mm/s (WARNING) — schedule maintenance within 24 h.
RULE-ST04-02: VIB > 0.35 mm/s (CRITICAL) — emergency stop; inspect bearings.
RULE-ST04-03: SPD drops below 1.00 m/s without operator command — verify RULE-ST02-04.
2.5 SRV01_SERVERROOM
RULE-SRV01-01: TMP MUST NOT exceed 25°C.
RULE-SRV01-02: TMP > 28°C (CRITICAL) — automatic controlled shutdown of all PLC nodes.
2.6 WRH01_WAREHOUSE (General Warehouse)
RULE-WRH01-01: TMP MUST remain between 0.5°C and 8°C. CRITICAL above 12°C — notify QC and quarantine batch.
RULE-WRH01-02: HUM above 85%RH — inspect door seals and activate dehumidifier.
2.7 CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE (Chemical Storage)
RULE-CHM01-01: TMP MUST remain between 10°C and 20°C. CRITICAL above 25°C — activate emergency ventilation and notify safety officer immediately.
RULE-CHM01-02: HUM MUST NOT exceed 50%RH. Elevated humidity accelerates degradation of hygroscopic reagents. Activate desiccant system if HUM >45%RH.
RULE-CHM01-03: Only personnel with hazmat training (technician/supervisor/manager role) are authorised to enter Chemical Storage. UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS must be escalated within 2 minutes.
2.8 RND01_RDLAB (R&D Lab)
RULE-RND01-01: TMP MUST remain between 18°C and 26°C for experimental validity.
RULE-RND01-02: HUM drift above 65%RH — activate dehumidifier. Above 75%RH (CRITICAL) — suspend sensitive experiments and inspect HVAC system.
2.9 CAF01_CAFETERIA
RULE-CAF01-01: TMP above 26°C — check ventilation system. Occupant comfort is the primary criterion.
RULE-CAF01-02: HUM above 70%RH — inspect drainage and activate ventilation.

Anomaly Type Definitions for KG Mapping

[SOP-002:p2:table6] Anomaly Type Definitions for KG Mapping
Type: SPIKE; Definition: Transient deviation >3σ, <5 min; Detection Criterion: Single reading >CRIT; Ontology Class: AnomalyEvent::Spike
Type: DRIFT; Definition: Monotonic deviation >15 min; Detection Criterion: Slope >0.1σ/min for 5+ readings; Ontology Class: AnomalyEvent::Drift
Type: STUCK; Definition: Unchanged >10 consecutive readings; Detection Criterion: std(last 10)<0.001×nominal; Ontology Class: AnomalyEvent::StuckSensor
Type: OUT_OF_RANGE; Definition: Sustained WARN violation >10 min; Detection Criterion: >WARN for 20+ readings; Ontology Class: AnomalyEvent::OutOfRange
Type: CORRELATED; Definition: Causally linked to another station; Detection Criterion: Onset within 90 min of cause; Ontology Class: AnomalyEvent::Correlated

Predictive & Corrective Maintenance Rules — Production
Line A
Document: SOP-003 | Rev: 1.5 | Date: 2025-09-01 | Author: Ing. A. Conti — Maintenance Engineering
1. Predictive Maintenance Rules

[SOP-003:p1:table1] 1. Predictive Maintenance Rules
Rule ID: MAINT-01; Sensor: VIB; Station: ST04_PACKAGING; Trigger: VIB DRIFT >0.05 mm/s over 60 min; Action: Inspect and lubricate bearing; Priority: HIGH
Rule ID: MAINT-02; Sensor: CUR; Station: ST02_SEALING; Trigger: CUR DRIFT >1.0 A for 30+ min; Action: Inspect sealing jaw; Priority: HIGH
Rule ID: MAINT-03; Sensor: TEN; Station: ST03_LABELLING; Trigger: TEN STUCK >10 samples; Action: Replace sensor; Priority: MEDIUM
Rule ID: MAINT-04; Sensor: PRS; Station: ST01_FILLING; Trigger: PRS <3.3 bar for >15 min; Action: Inspect filter and pump; Priority: MEDIUM
Rule ID: MAINT-05; Sensor: TMP; Station: SRV01_SERVERROOM; Trigger: TMP >25°C for >5 min; Action: Activate secondary cooling; Priority: CRITICAL
Rule ID: MAINT-06; Sensor: TMP; Station: WRH01_WAREHOUSE; Trigger: TMP DRIFT >2°C over 2 h; Action: Inspect compressor; notify QC; Priority: CRITICAL
Rule ID: MAINT-07; Sensor: TMP; Station: CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE; Trigger: TMP >20°C for >10 min; Action: Emergency ventilation; notify safety officer; Priority: CRITICAL
Rule ID: MAINT-08; Sensor: HUM; Station: RND01_RDLAB; Trigger: HUM DRIFT >10%RH over 60 min; Action: Activate dehumidifier; check HVAC drain; Priority: HIGH
2. Correlated Fault Resolution

[SOP-003:p1:table2] 2. Correlated Fault Resolution
Pattern: ST02_SEALING-CUR↑ → ST04_PACKAGING-SPD↓; Primary Fault: Sealing motor overload; Secondary Effect: Conveyor speed drop via electrical coupling; Resolution: 1.Verify ST02-CUR trend. 2.Inspect sealing jaw. 3.Reset ST04 speed setpoint.
Pattern: SRV01-TMP↑ → SCADA latency↑; Primary Fault: Server Room overheating; Secondary Effect: Increased scan time → apparent STUCK readings; Resolution: 1.Reduce SRV01-TMP <25°C. 2.Verify PLC heartbeats. 3.Clear STUCK alarms.
Pattern: WRH01-TMP↑ → QC HOLD; Primary Fault: Cold warehouse drift; Secondary Effect: Product quality risk; Resolution: 1.Restore WRH01-TMP <8°C. 2.Notify QC. 3.Place batch on HOLD in ERP.

text: 4. Unauthorised Access Rules
RULE-ACCESS-01: Any entry by an unauthorised role MUST be logged as OccupancyEvent::UnauthorisedAccess with person_id, zone, and timestamp.
RULE-ACCESS-02: Security personnel MUST be notified within 2 minutes of detection.
RULE-ACCESS-03: The KG node MUST include authorized=NO and a reference to this rule.
RULE-ACCESS-04: Chemical Storage has zero-tolerance policy. Any UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS triggers immediate escalation to the Safety Officer regardless of role.
